title: TawTaw Store
description: A full-featured e-commerce platform where users can browse products, add items to their cart, and complete secure purchases.

title: Memora
description: An interactive flashcard learning platform that helps students study and memorize information effectively through spaced repetition and a massive library of study sets.

title: VitaCare
description: A comprehensive health tracking application that allows users to monitor their vital signs, track medications and maintain a personal health diary with secure data management.

title: SuperCleaner
description: A Chrome extension that lets users permanently hide unwanted elements on websites, such as ads, pop-ups, images, and cluttered sections.

title: CryptoVerse
description: A web-based cryptography demo showcasing hybrid encryption using TRNG-generated RSA keys from a Raspberry Pi and AES-256-GCM via the Web Crypto API.

title: TawTaw Chat
description: A terminal-based messaging application that enables real-time communication between users on the same system through an elegant command-line interface with beautiful visual design.
